records.issue_text: For mem-only indexes, concurrent builders duplicate the full build and the loser's index and documents are silently discarded when the winner's entry overwrites b.cache[key], a lost-update/data-loss race
records.rationale: In `pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go`, `BuildIndex` removed the mutex lock that previously serialized the entire build (`b.cacheMu.Lock()/defer Unlock()`), and now only locks around `b.cache[key] = idx`. This allows two goroutines building the same `key` concurrently to both do a full build and then race to assign into `b.cache`, where the later assignment overwrites the earlier entry. The overwritten built index (and its populated documents) becomes unreachable/ignored, matching the described lost-update/discard behavior.
